entries.symbol_notes: Historical TAS watch list labels a 16-bit unsigned booster meter. Static writer scan run 36769525945 finds coherent bank-02 word operations, including `REP #$20; LDA #$0000; STA $11CD` at `02:9BA6` plus word-style arithmetic/store sequences at `02:A768` and nearby routines. USJO v8 intentionally reads only the low byte as `realboostmeter` and uses it solely as a zero/nonzero gate; exact game-facing boost units still need dynamic validation.
